about: The only facts a Short may state. A script line lists the IDs it uses in "facts".
status: confirmed (may be stated), reported (may be stated only in its safe wording), unverified (may not be used).
Only the owner changes a status or gives a new fact as confirmed. Claude adds new facts as unverified and never marks one confirmed on its own.
safe_wording is how to say it on screen and in the voice. also_ok lists other wordings that are just as safe.
Every number a line says or shows must be in the wording of a fact that line lists (for a reported fact: in its safe wording).
source is the main link and more_sources lists the others that say the same.

facts.claim: GTA 6 launches 19 Nov 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
facts.safe_wording: GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
facts.note: The summary of Rockstar's Newswire post of 3 Nov 2026 says "when it launches on November 19".

facts.claim: Digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on 10 Nov 2026.
facts.safe_wording: digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10
facts.note: Until 2026-11-12 this fact said November 12, which was Rockstar's June date. The owner corrected it. The title of Rockstar's post is "Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10". Rockstar's own pages would not open for Claude on 2026-11-12 (the Newswire page loads only its title and summary, the support pages time out), so the wording was read on the news sites listed.

facts.claim: Digital pre-load on Xbox Series X|S opened for everyone at the same moment, reported as 12 a.m. GMT on 10 Nov 2026 (the evening of 9 Nov in the Americas).
facts.safe_wording: on Xbox, pre-load reportedly opened at midnight GMT on November 10
also_ok: on Xbox, pre-load reportedly opened at 12 a.m. GMT on November 10
on Xbox it reportedly opened at midnight GMT on November 10
facts.note: The owner said to keep this reported unless Rockstar's own wording is found. timesaver.gg prints it as a quote from Rockstar's support page: "On XBOX Series X|S, digital pre-load begins globally at 12 a.m. GMT on November 10, 2026." Rockstar's own pages would not open for Claude on 2026-11-12 (the Newswire page loads only its title and summary, the support pages time out), so the wording was read on the news sites listed. If the owner sees that sentence on Rockstar's page, this can be confirmed. The also_ok wordings were added by Claude and keep the word "reportedly".

facts.claim: Rockstar's update of 3 Nov 2026 moved digital pre-load forward from November 12 to November 10.
facts.safe_wording: Rockstar moved digital pre-load forward from November 12 to November 10
facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-12. TechPowerUp: digital pre-orders start "on November 10, instead of the November 12 date announced back in June".

facts.claim: November 12 is the date for boxed (retail) copies, which hold a download code and no disc. It is not the digital pre-load date.
facts.safe_wording: boxed copies arrive in shops from November 12
facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-12. It replaces the unverified fact code-in-box-nov-12. TechPowerUp says the date "reportedly still stands" and digitbin says copies are "expected at retailers from November 12".

facts.claim: The pre-load needs up to 212 GB of free space, depending on the device. Rockstar gave no figure for each console.
facts.safe_wording: up to 212 GB of free space
facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-12. Rockstar's wording as the news sites quote it: "up to 212 GB of available space depending on your device". It replaces ps5-download-size ("over 200 GB", reported) and ps5-size-212-gb (unverified); neither figure was only about PS5. "gigabytes" and "gigs" count as GB.

facts.claim: Rockstar says GTA 6 releases at midnight local time on 19 Nov 2026 in all regions, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
facts.safe_wording: Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19
also_ok: unlocks at midnight local time on November 19
facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-12; until then this fact was reported ("expected to unlock"). timesaver.gg and Forbes quote Rockstar's support page: "Grand Theft Auto VI will release midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions for both PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S." Rockstar's own pages would not open for Claude on 2026-11-12 (the Newswire page loads only its title and summary, the support pages time out), so the wording was read on the news sites listed. See us-store-eastern-midnight for what "local" may mean in the US. The also_ok wordings were added by Claude.

facts.claim: Six confirmed major regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park.
facts.safe_wording: six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Grassrivers, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park

facts.claim: GTA 5 released in 2013, so the wait for GTA 6 is about 13 years.
facts.safe_wording: GTA 5 came out in 2013, so the wait for GTA 6 is about 13 years
facts.note: Until 2026-11-12 this fact had no source link and also said "the longest gap between main GTA games". Claude found a link for the 13 years but not for the longest gap, which is now its own unverified fact, longest-gta-gap.

facts.claim: Pre-loading does not let you play early.
facts.safe_wording: pre-loading does not let you play early
facts.note: Until 2026-11-12 this fact had no source link. timesaver.gg: "One thing preload does not do is let you play early." gtabase: "Pre-loading is not early access."

facts.claim: The 13 years between GTA 5 and GTA 6 is the longest gap between main GTA games.
facts.safe_wording: the longest gap between main GTA games
facts.note: Split from thirteen-year-wait on 2026-11-12. Claude saw it only in a search summary and could not open a page that says it.

facts.claim: In the US the stores are reported to unlock the game for the whole country at midnight Eastern, which is 9 p.m. Pacific on 18 Nov.
facts.safe_wording: in the US it is reported to unlock at midnight Eastern, 9 p.m. Pacific on November 18
facts.note: Added by Claude on 2026-11-12 for the owner to check. Rockstar has not said this; it comes from store listings. It matters to unlock-time: "midnight local time" may not be each US time zone's own midnight.

facts.claim: New Zealand gets the game first, because it unlocks at midnight in each time zone.
facts.safe_wording: New Zealand gets it first
facts.note: From both nov10_preload scripts. It depends on unlock-time.

facts.claim: Turning on auto-download lets the pre-load start by itself.
facts.safe_wording: turn on auto-download and let it run
facts.note: From both nov10_preload scripts.
